<thought>We need a template that forms a sulfonamide (functional group “sulfonamides”) by creating an S‑N bond (16‑7) and breaking an S‑Cl bond (16‑17). Using a simple phenyl‑sulfonamide as the target molecule, we search the template catalog with these criteria and the correct functional group name.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "c1ccc(cc1)S(=O)(=O)N",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["sulfonamides"],
    "bonds_formed": ["16-7"],
    "bonds_broken": ["16-17"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
